newsitem.title: USA: Bayer withdraws laxative from U.S. market.
newsitem.headline: Bayer withdraws laxative from U.S. market.

text.p: Bayer Corp's Consumer Care Division said Monday that it will voluntarily withdraw its Phillips' Gelcaps laxative from the U.S. market.

Bayer said the action is being taken in response to concerns expressed by a committee of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration regarding phenolphtalein, an ingredient in its laxative, and cancer in laboratory animals.

The comapny said that its Phillips' Milk of Magnesia, its Phillips' Chewable Tablets and its Haley's MO do not contain phenolphtalein, nor any other similar ingredient, and remain on the market. Bayer Corp is a division of Bayer AG.
